name: pmusic_peig
comment: Sig: [P,f]=pmusic(x,p,nfft,fs) / peig(...). MUSIC + eigenvector subspace pseudospectra: R=X'X (order 2p via corrmtx) -> eig -> noise subspace (smallest p eigvecs) -> P(w)=1/sum|e'vk|^2 (pmusic) or weighted 1/lambda_k (peig). PEAK-FREQUENCY parity only (this is a frequency estimator): the absolute pseudospectrum is scale-arbitrary + eigendecomposition-sensitive (peaks are 1/near-zero) so it is NOT bit-matched to MATLAB; the fingerprints are the detected peak FREQUENCIES + grid shape. Fixes bugs/signal/pmusic-peig (were undefined). Verified vs MATLAB R2025b: two-tone cos(2pi*0.1 n)+cos(2pi*0.25 n) -> peaks at 0.6381 and 1.5708 rad/sample for both pmusic and peig; 129 one-sided bins on [0,pi].
